gate.meaning: small-sample usability check of the full read per (task, length) cell; not a quality claim; B/C/D0 are compared only in usable cells

status: v3 software correction 2026-10-18; NOT_RUN. Formal results use archived v2, never relabelled or rerun.

index.note: the same untrained GroupedIndexer as G1b (seed * 1000 + layer per layer); D0 = its top-k, never called 'random selection'

B.label: 近期窗口：F ∪ 最近 k 个候选位置

C.label: 均匀随机：F ∪ 候选域内均匀抽取 k 个位置（固定种子，每层每组独立）

D0.label: 未训练索引：F ∪ 随机初始化 GroupedIndexer 打分 top-k

budget_rule: k0 = min(round(rho * N0), candidates at N0) with N0 = prefix tokens + 1 (the first decode step); fixed within a request; k = min(k0, candidates now)

protocol.name: document_dense_then_sparse
protocol.prefix: chat-template head + header + record table + table_end, processed once with the full read (chunk 2048) while the index table is built; the question is not part of the shared prefix
protocol.per_method: an independent clone of the prefix cache; from the first question token on, every token (question, template suffix, generated) is one decode step read by the method's own selector
protocol.rewrites: rebuild the prefix from scratch; no KV reuse across variants

seeds.uniform_rule: uniform_seed = uniform_base + (sha256(parent_doc_id or doc_id) first 32 bits mod 2^20); per-step numpy SeedSequence([uniform_seed, request_counter, step_index]); matching selections require identical candidate domain and k; D0 remains content-responsive

data.header: 下面是一份工作记录，其中穿插着若干条编号记录，格式为「编号 X：Y」，Y 是编号 X 对应的四位数值。

question.T1: 问题：编号 {id} 对应的数值是多少？只输出该编号对应的四位数值，不要输出编号。
question.T2: 问题：编号 {id1} 对应的数值和编号 {id2} 对应的数值分别是多少？按这个顺序只输出这两个四位数值，用逗号隔开，不要输出编号。

front.note: first fifth of the body records

back_near.note: the last record, line end 30-70 tokens before the prefix end

back_far.note: the second-to-last record, 150-250 tokens before the prefix end

data.t2_order_rule: even doc index: ascending position; odd doc index: descending position

move_case_rule.condition: A exact_match and B not exact_match at rho 1/32, else at rho 1/8; lowest doc indices first; T2 moves the queried record that is farther from the end; skipped when the queried record already is the back_near record

layout.note: the last two records are tail records at controlled distances (back_near 32-60 so the line lies inside B's window at every (length, rho) and outside F's recent 64; back_far 150-250 so it is inside B's window only when 64 + k0 - Q >= ~262); the other n-2 are spread evenly; filler is digit-free prose from filler_pool

data.move_rule: swap the queried record with the back_near tail record (same layout)

prompt.chat_template: the tokenizer's own template at the pinned revision
prompt.prefix_boundary: the rendered text before the question marker '问题：'; checked to be an exact token prefix of the full prompt

generation.stop_rule: stop when the argmax token is an EOS id or when 64 tokens have been generated; the EOS token counts toward the 64 but is not part of the text; truncated = no EOS within 64

parsing.T1: the first standalone four-digit number in the generated text must equal the target
parsing.T2: the first two standalone four-digit numbers must equal the two targets in the asked order

run.record_selection_positions_at: the step that produces the first generated token (per layer, per group, bitset over positions)
run.coverage: per decode step and layer, how many of the queried records' token positions each group read (counts only; no attention weights)
